raw_text: Internet shutdown imposed in Shopian and Pulwama districts following encounter. But posts still appearing via VPN tunnels. Timed message bursts detected — coordinated protest calls going out at exact 30-minute intervals. Stone pelting reported at three locations near encounter site. Security forces using tear gas.
